# chunk_redundancy { #dyf.chunk_redundancy }

```python
chunk_redundancy(bucket_ids, doc_ids)
```

Count same-doc siblings sharing each point's bucket.

For each point, returns how many *other* chunks from the same document
landed in the same bucket. 0 means unique in its bucket for that document.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type   | Description                                                 | Default    |
|------------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| bucket_ids |        | Array-like of bucket assignments per point.                 | _required_ |
| doc_ids    |        | Array-like of document identifiers per point (same length). | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                     | Description                                                       |
|--------|------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | Integer array of length len(bucket_ids). Each value is the number |
|        | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | of same-doc siblings in the same bucket (excluding self).         |
